topic: Myth vs fact: does eaten collagen go straight to your skin? Gut enzymes cut it into amino acids and di/tripeptides; di/tripeptides are absorbed by the transporter PEPT1 (Spanier 2014); Pro-Hyp found in blood, peak 1-2 h after gelatin hydrolysate (Iwai 2005); skin fibroblasts make their own collagen, vitamin C is a cofactor (StatPearls); 2025 meta-analysis of 23 RCTs: independent and high-quality trials showed no clear skin benefit (Myung & Park 2025)

fact-check collagen

Does eating collagen go straight to your skin?

STEP 1 · GUT

Chopped up.

Gut enzymes cut collagen into amino acids and 2–3 amino acid pieces.

STEP 2 · BLOOD

Pro-Hyp

A 2-amino-acid collagen piece. In blood, it peaked 1–2 hours after eating.

// Iwai et al., 2005

STEP 3 · SKIN

Built on site.

Skin cells called fibroblasts make collagen, using vitamin C.

VERDICT · 23 TRIALS

Independent, high‑quality trials showed no clear skin benefit.

// Myung & Park, Am J Med 2025
